facts.value: Provides Pikachu's knockback-entry callback by forwarding the fighter object to Fighter_OnKnockbackEnter with integer selector 1. The shared inline calls ftAnim_800704F0 for selectors 1 and 0 with value 3.0f; the callback itself performs no knockback-magnitude calculation.
facts.rationale: Replaces the misleading description of the second argument as an enabled option with its demonstrated integer-selector role, without assigning unverified animation-channel semantics.

evidence.why: Shared helper takes s32 and forwards it alongside a separate selector-0 call.
